trace.question: How long do we have to dispute a missing-item chargeback on a DoorDash order?
trace.answer:
The policies don't give a dispute deadline for DoorDash. They also say Ridgeline Coffee isn't on any delivery marketplace, so there should be no DoorDash orders to dispute. Anyone asking about DoorDash, Uber Eats or Grubhub should be told we aren't on them [Online Ordering and Loyalty Policy §2, Delivery Marketplaces].

I found no marketplace terms covering chargeback windows. If you did get a DoorDash chargeback, send me the order and I'll look it up. I won't guess at a deadline.

trace.question: How long do we have to dispute a missing-item chargeback on a DoorDash order?
trace.answer:
I couldn't find a dispute deadline for DoorDash in your policies. The searches on DoorDash, marketplace disputes, and missing-item chargebacks returned nothing on point. The only section that came back was [House Policy §5, Online Orders]. It covers Square Online pickup orders and has nothing to do with marketplace disputes.

I won't guess at a number of days. Check the DoorDash merchant agreement or the DoorDash merchant portal for the current window. If you tell me about a specific order, I can look up its date and flag it for you so it isn't missed.
